checks.check: initial rating 1000 for both; a recipient win at 1000 v 1000 moves +20 / −20 (K 40)
a creator win moves the creator up and the recipient down by the expected amounts
a tie is 0.5 each: the higher-rated side gives up a little
the ledger holds one immutable event per rated attempt with both sides before/expected/delta/after
rating the same attempt again: already_rated, no second event, no second delta
refresh/retry (three re-rates of every event): profile unchanged
the profile equals the ledger: rating after the newest event, W-L-T from events
provisional: 3 / 5 matches and 2 / 3 unique opponents; no public rank
four matches, three opponents: still provisional (five needed)
five matches AND three opponents: PLACED
five matches against one opponent would not place (unique-opponent threshold is independent)
J reached ten rated matches (no pair spent more than three in seven days)
K is 40 for a player's first ten rated matches and 24 after
the floor: a rating never drops below 100 and the ledger's delta is the floored difference
the winner is unaffected by the loser's floor: the deltas are no longer symmetric there
